title: Every algebraic stack contains largest open substacks that are DM and quasi-DM
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack has a largest open DM substack and, inside it, a largest open quasi-DM substack (author lemma at source lines 4791-4799, label lemma-open-DM-locus). The proof (source lines 4801-4814) reduces the existence of the largest such open substacks to the closure of the property under unions of two open substacks, proves that closure by exhibiting surjective etale presentations of the two substacks and using the characterization theorem for the DM locus, and repeats the argument for quasi-DM (proof lines 4802-4813). The reduction and the union argument are the content. H2.
